segmente.text: Psychology says the reason your brand gets ignored is because you haven't made any enemies.
Have you ever been to a social event and got talking to a stranger?
You're getting on okay, but then you find out you both hate the same person.
Suddenly, you and that stranger like each other a lot more.
This is called the enemy effect.
It means when we share a common enemy with someone, we feel a stronger bond with them.
And every cult brand is using this trick to make customers loyal to them.
Teslas is cars that use gas.
The lesson is, if you want to build a cult brand, you must find out what your customer hates.
That, how you build a loyal customer base.
